title: Complete frontend rebuild with sleek marketplace UI

requirements.summary: Redesign the entire frontend with a sleek, minimalist e-commerce aesthetic inspired by reference images, featuring clean product cards, smooth navigation, elegant typography, generous white space, and a cohesive visual identity for mobile and desktop
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile UI matches the clean card-based layout and navigation patterns from image-10.png
Desktop UI reflects the spacious, elegant layout style from image-11.png
Responsive design adapts smoothly between mobile and desktop breakpoints
Typography, spacing, and color choices create a premium, cohesive brand feel
All interactive elements have smooth transitions and hover states

file_operations.description: Update global CSS with new color palette (warm earth tones avoiding blue/purple), refined typography scale using modern font stack, consistent spacing utilities, smooth transition defaults, and refined theme variables matching the premium minimalist aesthetic from reference images

Configure Tailwind with custom color palette (warm neutrals, earth tones), refined typography settings, consistent spacing scale, smooth animation timing functions, and responsive breakpoint adjustments to support the sleek design system

Redesign ListingCard component to match the clean product card style from image-10.png with refined image handling, elegant typography hierarchy, smooth hover transitions, proper spacing, and prominent save/cart actions. Use generated images from frontend/public/assets/generated/ as fallback placeholders when needed

Update AppShell layout to provide refined structure with proper header spacing, elegant transitions, and cohesive wrapper styling that supports both mobile card-based layouts and desktop spacious designs
Redesign TopBar with minimalist aesthetic, refined navigation controls, elegant search integration, and smooth transitions matching reference image styling
Update BottomTabs with cleaner icon styling, smooth active state transitions, refined spacing, and cohesive visual treatment matching the sleek design system

requirements.summary: Implement campus verification system supporting both .edu email verification and manual campus selection during onboarding, storing campus affiliation in user profiles
acceptanceCriteria: Onboarding flow includes campus selection or email verification step
Backend validates .edu email domains
User profile stores verified campus affiliation
UI clearly indicates verification status

file_operations.description: Add email verification field with .edu domain detection, integrate verification status display, and provide fallback manual campus selection option. Include visual feedback for verified status with elegant badge styling matching the new design system
Add campus verification badge display with refined styling to show verified campus affiliation status on user profiles and listings

requirements.summary: Enable sellers to upload multiple photos per listing (up to 5 images), manage pricing, mark items as sold, and control inventory status with an intuitive listing management interface
acceptanceCriteria: Listing creation supports uploading up to 5 photos
Sellers can reorder photos via drag-and-drop
Sold status can be toggled on listings
My Listings page shows inventory status clearly

file_operations.description: Ensure ImagePicker supports up to 5 images with drag-and-drop reordering, refined upload UI with progress indicators, elegant preview styling, and smooth transitions. Use the blob-storage component for handling image uploads. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing
Add sold status toggle button with optimistic UI updates, inventory status badge display, and elegant status indicators matching the new design aesthetic
Update My Listings page to clearly show inventory status with refined status badges, sold/active filtering options, and clean card-based layout matching the new design system

requirements.summary: Build advanced search and filtering UI with category-specific filters for campus needs including textbooks, furniture, electronics, clothing, dorm essentials, course materials, and move-out sales, with sort options and price ranges
acceptanceCriteria: Search page includes category chips for all campus-specific categories
Filters support price range, condition, and campus location
Sort options include price, date posted, and relevance
Filter state persists across page navigation

file_operations.description: Redesign search page with refined filtering UI, elegant category chip layout matching reference designs, smooth filter transitions, and clean results grid. Add campus-specific categories (textbooks, furniture, electronics, clothing, dorm essentials, course materials, move-out sales)
Add campus location filter, condition filter, and refine price range controls with elegant UI styling, smooth interactions, and clear filter state display
Update category chips to include all campus-specific categories with refined styling, smooth selection transitions, and clear active state indicators
Extend filtering logic to support campus location, condition filtering, and ensure all campus-specific categories are properly handled in filter application
Extend filter persistence to include campus location and condition filters, ensuring state persists across navigation

requirements.summary: Create comprehensive user profile pages displaying seller ratings, listing history, verification badges, campus affiliation, and trust indicators
acceptanceCriteria: Profile page shows user's active and sold listings
Seller rating displayed prominently with review count
Verification badges visible for verified users
Campus affiliation shown on profile

file_operations.description: Redesign profile page with elegant layout showing seller rating prominently, listing history tabs (active/sold), verification badges, campus affiliation display, and trust indicators. Use clean card-based sections with refined typography and spacing matching the new design system
Ensure verification badges and trust indicators are displayed prominently on profile page with refined styling and proper spacing

requirements.summary: Implement buyer-seller messaging system with thread-based conversations, typing indicators, read receipts, and quick offer buttons for seamless communication
acceptanceCriteria: Users can initiate chat from listing detail pages
Chat interface shows typing indicators
Read receipts indicate when messages are seen
Quick offer button pre-fills common message templates

file_operations.description: Redesign chat interface with refined message bubbles, elegant typing indicator display, clear read receipt indicators, and smooth message transitions. Add quick offer button integration matching the sleek design aesthetic
Refine quick offer button styling with elegant hover states and smooth interactions, ensuring it stands out while maintaining design cohesion
Ensure typing status updates are properly debounced and integrated with the backend for smooth real-time indicator display
Redesign inbox page with clean thread list layout, refined ThreadListItem styling, and elegant empty state matching the new design system
Update thread list item with refined styling, clear unread indicators, elegant timestamp display, and smooth hover transitions

requirements.summary: Implement urgent sale tags for end-of-semester listings, allowing sellers to mark listings as time-sensitive and prioritizing them in search results and feeds
acceptanceCriteria: Sellers can toggle 'Urgent Sale' flag on listings
Urgent sale badge displays prominently on listing cards
Urgent listings appear higher in search results
Feed algorithms prioritize urgent sale items

file_operations.description: Add urgent sale badge display with prominent styling (e.g., accent color, border, or corner badge) that stands out while maintaining design cohesion
Add urgent sale toggle option in the sell wizard with clear description of its purpose and effect, styled elegantly within the form flow
Update feed algorithms to prioritize urgent sale listings by boosting their ranking scores in trending and recommended feeds
Update sort logic to prioritize urgent sale listings when sorting by relevance or date, ensuring they appear higher in search results

requirements.summary: Add campus meetup location suggestions feature that recommends safe, public meeting spots on campus when buyers and sellers arrange transactions
acceptanceCriteria: Listing detail or chat UI suggests common campus meetup spots
Suggestions include library, student center, main quad, etc.
Users can select from suggested locations in chat
Safety tips accompany meetup suggestions

file_operations.description: Add meetup location suggestions section with list of common campus spots (library, student center, main quad, dining hall) styled elegantly with location icons and selection mechanism
Integrate meetup location suggestions into chat interface as selectable chips or quick actions, allowing users to easily share location suggestions in messages
Update safety tips banner to include meetup location guidance and ensure it displays alongside location suggestions with cohesive styling

requirements.summary: Implement saved searches feature allowing users to save search queries with filters and receive notifications when new listings match their saved criteria
acceptanceCriteria: Users can save current search query and filters
Saved searches accessible from user profile or search page
Backend checks new listings against saved searches
Notifications sent when matches are found

file_operations.description: Add save search button to search page that captures current query and filters, styled elegantly with prominent placement and clear call-to-action
Add saved searches section to profile page displaying list of saved queries with options to view, edit, or delete each search. Use clean card-based layout
Add storage key constant for saved searches persistence
Create persistence module for managing saved search queries in localStorage, including CRUD operations and list retrieval with proper typing
Add notification type handling for saved search matches with appropriate icon and message formatting

requirements.summary: Redesign home page with a premium dashboard layout featuring personalized listing recommendations, quick action cards, recently viewed items strip, trending section, and campus-specific widgets, all styled with the new minimalist aesthetic
acceptanceCriteria: Home page uses card-based layout matching reference designs
Personalized recommendations section displays relevant listings
Quick actions provide shortcuts to key features

file_operations.description: Redesign home page with refined card-based dashboard layout matching image-10.png mobile aesthetic and image-11.png desktop spaciousness. Integrate hero banner using frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png, ensure all sections (stats, quick actions, widgets, saved items, recommendations, trending) use cohesive spacing and elegant typography
Refine quick action cards with elegant icons, refined typography, smooth hover transitions, and clear visual hierarchy matching the sleek design system
Update stats row with refined metric display, elegant number formatting, and cohesive spacing matching the premium aesthetic
Redesign widgets grid with clean card styling, refined spacing, and elegant layout matching reference image designs
Update recently viewed strip with refined horizontal scroll styling, elegant card design, smooth scroll behavior, and cohesive spacing
Redesign trending section with clean horizontal layout, refined listing cards, and elegant section header matching the new aesthetic
Update recommended section with refined styling, clean card layout, and cohesive design matching the premium marketplace feel
Refine personalized listings preview with elegant card styling, refined loading states, and smooth transitions matching the sleek design system

requirements.summary: Redesign listing detail pages with large image carousels, clear pricing and condition display, prominent save and cart actions, seller profile preview, chat button, and integrated safety tips, following the clean product detail layout from the reference images
acceptanceCriteria: Image carousel displays multiple photos with smooth navigation
Product details laid out cleanly with clear hierarchy
Save and cart buttons prominent and accessible
Seller profile card shows rating and verification status

file_operations.description: Redesign listing detail page matching the clean product detail layout from image-11.png with refined image carousel, clear pricing and condition display, prominent save/cart actions, elegant seller profile preview card, accessible chat button, and integrated safety tips banner. Use frontend/public/assets/generated/product-placeholder.dim_400x400.png as fallback for missing images. Ensure layout adapts elegantly between mobile and desktop
Update image carousel with refined navigation controls, smooth transitions, elegant pagination indicators, and proper image sizing matching the premium aesthetic
Refine safety tips banner styling to integrate seamlessly into listing detail layout with cohesive design and proper spacing

requirements.summary: Redesign search results page with grid-based listing cards, elegant filtering UI, category browsing chips, and smooth transitions, maintaining the minimalist aesthetic across mobile and desktop
acceptanceCriteria: Listing cards arranged in responsive grid
Filter controls accessible and intuitive
Category chips allow quick category switching
Smooth animations on filter changes and loading states

file_operations.description: Redesign search results page with responsive grid layout matching reference image styling, refined filter controls, elegant category chips, smooth transitions on filter changes, and cohesive mobile/desktop adaptation
Refine filters bottom sheet with elegant UI controls, clear filter display, smooth slide-up animation, and cohesive styling matching the new design system
